name: Magadh Sugar & Energy Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Magadh Sugar & Energy Ltd manufactures and sells sugar and its by-products, denatured  spirits, and power[1]
keyPoints:
Busienss Overview:[1]
MSEL deals in sugar and sugar products, spirits and alcohol of denatured of any strength, and 
sugar by-products, generation of power, etc.

Company has a low return on equity of 13.1% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
